consumer: The dialogue/condition has_items lambda built by set_has_items, which the border guard's search evaluates as a yes/no: does the avatar actor possess the contraband item.
scope: only the character's own carried items (wielded/worn/inventory) as counted by the engine's has_charges/has_amount over that actor
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t::set_has_items builds a predicate lambda that returns actor->has_charges(item_id,count) || actor->has_amount(item_id,count) — an engine-COMPUTED possession verdict consumed by a condition check, not a display.
divergence: The contraband is stashed inside a carried gun or magazine: a snapshot re-derivation that walks visit_internal stops descending into guns/magazines (Excerpt 3) and would report 'not carried', but the engine's has_amount predicate counts it as possessed — exposing the wrong answer.
